We are a group of volunteers for the West LA Animal Shelter located at 11361 W Pico Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90064. These videos were made to introduce the dogs currently residing at the facility and to show more of their personalities while they play in the yard. We are volunteers and do not work at the shelter so if you would like information on any of the dogs featured on this channel, please call West LA and provide the ID number of the dog.

Our hope is that these videos will help these wonderful dogs get adopted!
